F2: The new goroutines turn legacy errors into a metric boolean and never log them, and they have no panic recovery, so legacy failures are now silent.

F5: Line 139 hands legacy the raw `objInfo` instead of wrapping the result storage persisted, so legacy works out its own update and can persist something different from storage.
